observation.visible_scene: An overhead, static view of a flat white surface holding a lattice structure built from polished silver magnetic spheres (used as joints) and chains of small square magnetic tiles (used as struts/edges). The fixed upper portion is a truss-like panel: a top rectangular frame of tile chains with diagonal X-bracing between rows of spheres, a middle row of four spheres, and a bottom row of four spheres. Four tile-chain 'legs' hang downward from the bottom row. Shiny tile faces show reddish reflections of the surroundings (reflections, not separate objects).
visible_changes: For the first ~0.3 s the structure is fully static with the four legs ending in bare tile chains (no sphere at the tips).
Around t=0.4–0.5 s a sphere becomes attached to the tip of the outer-left leg and the outer-right leg (a fingertip briefly enters at the lower-left during this change).
Around t=1.0–1.2 s spheres are added to the tips of the two inner legs; for a moment the inner tip spheres appear detached/floating near the leg ends before seating.
From t=1.2–1.5 s the two inner legs tilt inward so that their tip spheres meet and touch at the bottom center, forming a V.

From t=1.6 s onward the legs are reconfigured into a horizontal bottom row: the inner legs stand vertical and tile chains are laid horizontally between the bottom spheres, progressively closing the row into three side-by-side squares (the leftmost connection is completed last, with a hand entering at the lower-left around t=1.8–2.3 s to place/adjust the left horizontal chain).

At t=2.5–2.7 s the outer-left leg and the leftmost bottom square deform: the left vertical chain bends outward and a diagonal tile chain forms a small triangle protruding to the left between the left sphere and the row above.
Throughout, the upper truss panel (top frame, X-braces, middle and bottom sphere rows) remains in the same position; only the lower legs/bottom row change.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the structure was assembled before the excerpt and what final shape (if any) the manipulation is heading toward.
The full sequence of the operator's hand actions between sampled frames (the hand is visible only intermittently at the bottom edge).
Whether the late left-side triangle is an intentional brace or an unintended collapse of that square.
uncertain_details: Exact instant each tip sphere was attached versus already present but out of frame; the hand's role in each addition is only partially visible.
Whether the camera is perfectly still or has very slight drift (background gives no clear parallax cue).
The reddish patches on tile faces are reflections, not colored tiles or separate objects.
